notes: Finished orders leave the Network Crafter's list: they show Done for 5 seconds (tap to clear at once) instead of offering to cancel. Orders can make charcoal from any log with an Electric Furnace on the network. Also in 4.51.1: network orders use any wood (any planks, slabs, logs), and the Crafter's Search works like the Deepcore Crafting Table's. 4.51.0: Assemblers work for network orders only.
